en: Sepia-toned panoramic view over a European city in a river valley, taken from an elevated hillside path where a person is seated in the lower right corner. A broad river curves through the center, flanked by dense blocks of multi‑story buildings and several church towers, with mountains in the background. A bridge crosses the river at the lower left. Along the right edge, in a small vertical script, is printed a caption.
